card.name: We believe / look forward statements
card.fires_on: Verbs of stance or aspiration after "we", such as "look forward", "believe", "envision", and words like "passion" or "passionate about", in institutional or mission-style web text.

modes.label: Look forward
modes.description: The word "forward" or "to" in "we look forward to" at the end of a welcome or announcement.
modes.example: Information for Students Welcome to the Flint Regional Science Fair! We look<< forward>> to seeing you at the Fair in March

modes.label: We believe / envision
modes.description: A stance verb right after "we" or a mission-style phrase, introducing a stated view or goal.
modes.example: We<< believe>> it is timely to remind the University community

modes.label: Passion or enthusiasm
modes.description: Words of enthusiasm such as passion or passionate, before what someone cares about.
modes.example: He is passionate<< about>> what the future of solar has in store

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words about interest, aspiration and opinion, such as "we think" and "interested in".
card.plain: It fires on phrases where an organization says what it believes, hopes for or looks forward to.
